<reason>Side B won the prioritisation clash: once Side A defended short-form as merely a doorway and creators as a durable in-house desk, B showed that justified using clips as a tool, not prioritising rented feeds and personalities over the universal services that deliver depth. B also sustained the creator-control dilemma and the owned-versus-rented distribution distinction.</reason>
